PRODUCT_NAME: Poretics 13 mm Hydrophilic Polycarbonate Track Etched (PCTE) Membranes, 0.01 um
DESCRIPTION:
Poretics™ PCTE Membranes are made from a thin, microporous polycarbonate film material. They are ideally suited for use in blood assays and high-purity and general filtration. Though polycarbonate is hydrophobic, theses membranes are treated with a wetting agent to make it hydrophilic.

Features and Benefits:
• Absolute pore size and density: Provides flow control for liquids moving through the membrane capturing 100% of cells larger than pore size
• Smooth, thin, glass-like surface: Planar surface makes it ideal for particle identification by microscopy
• Superior strength: Tensile strength of 207 bar (> 3000 psi) maintains pore size and density, and will not stretch
• Low extractables: Ensures tests will be clean promoting consistent results
• Low protein binding
• Negligible absorption/adsorption: Maximizes critical solution recovery

Applications:
• General filtration
• Removal of red blood cells from plasma
• Flow control of reagents through assay
• Precise filtration and prefiltration

Specifications:
• Diameter: 13 mm
• Sterilization: Gamma Irradiation or Ethylene Oxide (EtO)
• USP Class VI Testing: Passed
• Extractables: Very Low
• BSA Protein Binding: 5 g/cm2
• Max. Operating Temperature: 284°F (140°C)
• Sealing Compatibility: Ultrasonic, Heat, Radio Frequency and Insert Molding

DESCRIPTION:
Poretics™ PCTE Membranes are made from a thin, microporous polycarbonate film material. They are ideally suited for use in blood assays and high-purity and general filtration. Though polycarbonate is hydrophobic, theses membranes are treated with a wetting agent to make it hydrophilic.

Features and Benefits:
• Absolute pore size and density: Provides flow control for liquids moving through the membrane capturing 100% of cells larger than pore size
• Smooth, thin, glass-like surface: Planar surface makes it ideal for particle identification by microscopy
• Superior strength: Tensile strength of 207 bar (> 3000 psi) maintains pore size and density, and will not stretch
• Low extractables: Ensures tests will be clean promoting consistent results
• Low protein binding
• Negligible absorption/adsorption: Maximizes critical solution recovery

Applications:
• General filtration
• Removal of red blood cells from plasma
• Flow control of reagents through assay
• Precise filtration and prefiltration

• Diameter: 13 mm

• Extractables: Very Low
• BSA Protein Binding: 5 g/cm2
• Max. Operating Temperature: 284°F (140°C)

BALB/c Mouse Small Intestinal Microvascular Endothelial Cells are grown in T25 tissue culture flasks pre-coated with gelatin-based coating solution for 2 min and incubated in Creative Bioarray’ Culture Complete Growth Medium generally for 3-7 days. Cultures are then expanded. Prior to shipping, cells are detached from flasks and immediately cryo-preserved in vials. Each vial contains at least 1x10^6 cells per ml and are delivered frozen. The method we use to isolate endothelial cells was developed based on a combination of established and our proprietary methods. These cells are pre-coated with PECAM-1 antibody, following the application of magnetic pre-coated with secondary antibody.

DESCRIPTION: Lewis Rat Aortic Endothelial Cells from Creative Bioarray are isolated from aorta of 6-8 week old laboratory Lewis rat. Lewis Rat Aortic Endothelial Cells are grown in T75 tissue culture flasks pre-coated with gelatin-based coating solution for 2 min and incubated in Creative Bioarray’ Culture Complete Growth Medium generally for 3-7 days. Cultures are then expanded. Prior to shipping, cells at passage 3 are detached from flasks and immediately cryo-preserved in vials. Each vial contains at least 1x10^6 cells per ml and is delivered frozen. The method we use to isolate endothelial cells was developed based on a combination of established and our proprietary methods. These cells are pre-coated with PECAM-1 (CD31) antibody, following the application of magnetic beads pre-coated with secondary antibody.
